text:
Noah (AE): Handing off HelixCare (HC-331) to CS. TL;DR:
- Seats: 30 initial, upsell to 60 in Q3
- Env: Private (VPC), aiming for Dedicated on 2026-06-01
- Primary contact: j.santos@helixcare.com (Jorge, infra lead)
- Renewal: 2027-02-14
- Status: pilot feature set validated; blocked on SSO assertion and IP allowlist
- Risks: SSO cert timing + security review could slip go-live; medium renewal risk if >3 week delay
Links: contract https://redwood.app/contract/HC-331, pilot notes https://redwood.app/notebook/HC-331/notes

Priya (CS): I'll take ownership. Questions: who provides SAML metadata and when can we expect IP ranges? Also want to set three onboarding checkpoints for the customer.

Noah (AE): Jorge is SSO owner and will send metadata after ACS/Entity confirmation. They said IPs come from corporate network team and may take ~10 business days.

Lara (Enablement): I can run a 60-90m ops + runbook session for their SREs week of May 5. Priya, send attendee roles and preferred times.

Omar (Eng): Please open an infra ticket for VPC peering, NAT egress, and allowlist. Need expected qps and avg token length to size the dedicated pool. If dedicated by Jun 1, ticket needed by May 12. Example allowlist format requested from customer:
```
# allowlist example
172.20.0.0/16 -> peering
172.21.5.0/24 -> egress
```

Priya (CS): Added to onboarding tracker https://redwood.app/onboard/HC-331. Owners: Priya (CS) overall, Omar (Eng) infra, Lara enablement, Noah exec sponsor. Checkpoints: 1) SSO configured (wk1), 2) Peering & allowlist (wk2-3), 3) Canary traffic + perf test (wk4), 4) Prod cutover (target 2026-06-01).

Noah (AE): Mitigation: offer a hosted sandbox for early QA to reduce blockers. Renewal watch: escalate if peering/SSO slips more than 3w.

Omar (Eng): Need 10 sample prompts + traffic distribution (p90 tokens, qps) for perf runs. @Priya please add to tracker by EOD Thu.

Priya (CS): Will add prompts and success metrics: "<100ms median", "zero P0 in first 30d", "SSO in prod by cutover". Ping here for blockers.

Handoff Bot: Workspace created https://redwood.app/workspace/HC-331-onboard :white_check_mark:

Noah (AE): Thanks team :rocket: Assigning follow-ups: Priya to lead comms, Omar to open infra ticket by May 12, Lara to draft enablement agenda, Noah to run weekly exec sync until cutover.
